aboutMe.text: A passionate Software Developer dedicated to creating comprehensive and intelligent solutions, combining a solid foundation in Front-End with a growing focus on Back-End and Data Science.
🔹 FRONT-END: Extensive experience with Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, and NgRx in building responsive, scalable, and user-centric Single Page Applications (SPAs).
🔹 BACK-END (Current Focus): Advancing my skills in Java 17+, Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, and RESTful API architecture to build robust microservices and applications.

🔹 DATA SCIENCE: Finalizing a post-graduate degree in the field, acquiring knowledge in data analysis, SQL, and Machine Learning fundamentals to extract insights and add business value to applications.

🎯 GOAL: Focused on my evolution into a Full Stack Developer, integrating my solid Front-End experience with new skills in Back-End (Java) and Data Science to design and build end-to-end solutions that are both efficient and data-driven.
